description: Build the wiring module that connects supply_chain enrichment into signal_analyser_v2. Reads supply_chain_enrichment.py compute_score() output and writes to mcp_signal_enrichments via write_service with signal_type='supply_chain_enrichment'. Uses enrichment_harness pattern: read multiple fields (registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars) from metadata dict. Emits heartbeat to service_health. Supply_chain signal shows good discrimination (35 distinct values) so this enriches an already-strong signal.
